title: Red Dust, Last Uplink
premise: The crew of a Mars research habitat seals the airlocks as the infection spreads deck by deck, waiting for the ascent shuttle.
opening: Uplink in nine minutes. Get everyone to the pad before the dust storm closes the window.

rooms.title: Airlock Antechamber
rooms.description: Suit lockers and the inner-door console, dust still on the floor.
